SERVICE_DESCRIPTION.message: Le sevisi inika amandla ukuxhumeka okuzayo kusuka kumaklayenti we-Chromoting.

MAC_MICROPHONE_USAGE.message: Ukufinyelela kumakrofoni kuyadingeka ukuthatha umsindo nokuwusakaza kuklayenti yedeskithophu yesilawuli kude ye-Chrome.

ERROR_INCOMPATIBLE_PROTOCOL.message: Inguqulo yephrothokholi engahambisani iye yatholwa. Sicela wenze isiqiniseko sokuthi unenguqulo yakamuva yesofthiwe efakiwe kuwo womabili amakhompyutha uphinde uzame futhi.

ERROR_BAD_PLUGIN_VERSION.message: Ezinye izingxenye ezidingwayo azikho. Sicela uqiniseke ukuthi ufake inguqulo yakamuva yesofthiwe uphinde uzame futhi.

RESIZE_TO_CLIENT_SUBTITLE.message: Buyekeza ukulungiswa kwerimothi ukuze kumeshe iwindi

HOST_SETUP_STEP_1.message: Kukhompuyutha ofuna ukufinyelela kuyo ukuze, vula i-Chrome uphinde uvakashele i-$1$

HOST_SETUP_STEP_2.message: Landela imiyalo yokusetha ikhompyutha yakho ngokufinyelela kwerimothi

HOST_SETUP_STEP_3.message: ngemuva kokuthi ukusetha kuqedile, qalisa kabusha leli khasi, bese uzokwazi ukufinyelela ikhompyutha ngokukhetha idivayisi yakho nokufaka i-PIN

HOST_CONNECTED_ANNOUNCEMENT.message: Uxhumeke kudivayisi yakho yesilawuli kude. Ukuze uvule imenyu, sicela uthephe isikrini ngeminwe emine.

CONFIRM_HOST_DELETE.message: Ingabe uqinisekile ukuthi ufuna ukukhubaza ukuxhumeka kwesilawuli kude ku-$1$? Uma uguqula umcabango wakho, kuzomele uvakashele leyo khompyutha ukuze uphinde unike amandla ukuxhumeka.

CONFIRM_HOST_DELETE_ANDROID.message: Ingabe uqinisekile ukuthi ufuna ukususa ukuxhumeka kwesilawuli kude ku-%1$s?

CONTINUE_PROMPT.message: Okwamanje wabelana ngalo mshini nomunye umsebenzisi. Ingabe ufuna ukuqhubeka wabelane?

ERROR_HOST_OVERLOAD.message: Ukuxhumeka kukhompuyutha ekude manje kuvinjwe okwesikhashana ngoba umuntu othole ubekade ezama ukuxhumeka kuyo  ngephinikhodi engavumelekile. Sicela uzame futhi emuva kwesikhathi.

ERROR_HOST_CONFIGURATION_ERROR.message: Ikhompuyutha ekude ihlulekile ukuqalisa isikhathi. Uma inkinga iqhubeka sicela uzame ukulungiselela isikhungo futhi.

ERROR_HOST_IS_OFFLINE.message: Ikhompyutha eyisilawuli kude ayiphenduli izicelo zokuxhumeka. Sicela uqinisekise ukuthi iku-inthanethi uphinde uzame futhi.

ERROR_INVALID_ACCESS_CODE.message: Ikhodi yokufinyelela ayivumelekile. Sicela uzame futhi.

ERROR_INVALID_ACCOUNT.message: Izinqubomgomo zokuvikela kukhompuyutha yesilawuli kude azivumeli ukuxhumeka kusukela ku-akhawunti yakho.

ERROR_P2P_FAILURE.message: Ayikwazi ukufinyelela kumsingathi. Lokhu kungenzeka kubangelwe ukulungiselelwa kwenethiwekhi oyisebenzisayo.

ERROR_NETWORK_FAILURE.message: Ayikwazanga ukuxhumeka kunethiwekhi. Sicela uhlole ukuthi idivayisi yakho iku-inthanethi.

ERROR_OAUTH_TOKEN_INVALID.message: Kube nenkinga ukugunyaza, sicela ungene ngemvume futhi.

ERROR_UNEXPECTED.message: Kuvele iphutha elingaziwa. Sicela ubike le nkinga konjiniyela.

OFFLINE_REASON_LOGIN_SCREEN_NOT_SUPPORTE.message: Usokhaya osebenza kusikrini esihlakaniphile uvalile ukusekela imodi yekhethini ngokushintshela kusokhaya osebenza ngesikhathi somsebenzisi esithile.

OFFLINE_REASON_POLICY_CHANGE_REQUIRES_RE.message: Usokhaya uqalisa kabusha, ukuze azi ukuguqulwa kwenqubomgomo.

OFFLINE_REASON_X_SERVER_RETRIES_EXCEEDED.message: Iseva engu-X ikhubazekile noma ihluleke ukuqala.

OFFLINE_REASON_SESSION_RETRIES_EXCEEDED.message: Iseshini ikhubazekile noma ihlulekile ukuqala. Uma i-~/.chrome-remote-desktop-session ikhona kukhompuyutha yesilawuli kude, yenza isiqiniseko sokuthi iqala inqubo ebeyidala isebenza ngaphambili efana nemvelo yedeskithophu noma isiphathi sewindi.

PIN_MESSAGE_ANDROID.message: Sicela ufake iphinikhodi yakho kukhompyutha yesilawuli kude.

RESIZE_TO_CLIENT.message: Nika usayizi omusha ideskithophu ukuze kulingane

REMEMBER_PIN.message: Ungabuzi iphinikhodi futhi uma uxhumeka kulo msingathi kusuka kule divayisi.

REMOTING_NATIVE_MESSAGING_HOST_DESCRIPTI.message: Ukusingatha kokulayeza komdabu kokuphathwa kokusingatha kwesilawuli kude

HOST_CLIENT_ROUTING_CHANGED.message: I-IP yesiteshi yeklayenti: %1 ip='%2' host_ip='%3' channel='%4' connection='%5'.

SHARE_CONFIRM_DIALOG_MESSAGE.message: Ungathanda ukwabelana ngale khompyutha komunye umsebenzisi ukuthi abone futhi alawule?

SHARE_CONFIRM_DIALOG_MESSAGE_WITH_USERNA.message: Ungathanda ukuvumela i-{0} ukuthi ibone iphinde ilawule ikhompuyutha yakho?

SHARE_CONFIRM_DIALOG_MESSAGE_ADMIN_INITI.message: U-{0} ucele ukufinyelela ukuze abone isikrini sakho futhi alawule ikhobhodi negundane lakho. Cindezela u-''{1}'' uma ungalindele lesi sicelo. Kungenjalo khetha u-''{2}'' ukuvumela uxhumano uma usukulungele.

URL_FORWARDER_DESCRIPTION.message: Uhlelo lokusebenza lomsizi lokuvula i-URL kuklayenti ye-%s

SET_UP_URL_FORWARDER_PROMPT.message: Ukuvumela amalinki achofoziwe kudivayisi ekude ukuthi avulwe ku-browser yeklayenti, kudingeka ushitshe isistimu ye-browser ibe yi-"%s".

CHOOSE_FALLBACK_BROWSER.message: Ideskithophu Yesilawuli Kude ye-Chrome ayikwazi ukunquma isiphequluli ukuvula ama-URL endaweni. Sicela ukhethe ohlwini olungezansi.

BROWSER_IS_INVALID.message: I-browser ekhethiwe ayikwazi ukusetshenziselwa ukuvula ama-URL kumshini wasendaweni.

URL_FORWARDER_INCORRECTLY_CONFIGURED.message: I-%s ayilungiselelwanga kahle. Sicela ukhethe isiphequluli sewebhu esizenzakalelayo esihlukile bese uphinda unika amandla ukudluliselwa kwe-URL.
